name: Kroger Mid-Atlantic Distribution Center Salem VA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driver reviews describe checking in at a main gate then waiting for a text; satellite shows a controlled private drive off the Rt 460/W Main St signalized intersection into the campus, not an open road frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Driver reviews explicitly describe a 'main gate' plus a 'second guard shack' for check-in/check-out; manned booth.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Two-stage check-in confirmed by reviews: main gate, wait-for-text, then second guard shack before docks.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Large open paved truck-staging/overnight-parking lot near the highway (Street View shows tractors+trailers queued), ahead of the inner gate; reviews note ~20-25 overnight spots, angled stalls.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved entrance apron and ample staging width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple parallel rail tracks (Norfolk Southern, I-81 corridor) run hard against the building's north edge in z19-20 imagery; rail-served loading area visible.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: the main DC plus a separate fleet/trailer maintenance building to the SW and a refrigeration/canopy structure in the south yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on multiple building faces (long south wall + SE end) read as separate ship/rcv clusters; grocery DC handles reefer (meat/produce) and dry on distinct doors per reviews.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable in imagery and no review mentions one; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated from overhead bays + trailers backed in across the long south wall and SE end; reviews reference door 100+, consistent with a 50+ band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Salem VA at the foot of the Blue Ridge; open fields/creek/ball-fields adjoin the site (Street View shows mountains); broader setting is Rural.
